master.description: The location of the salt master server. If the master server cannot be resolved, then the minion will fail to start.

pidfile.description: Specify the location of the daemon process ID file.

conf_file.description: The path to the minion's configuration file.

pki_dir.description: The directory to store the pki information in

cachedir.description: Where cache data goes. This data may contain sensitive data and should be protected accordingly.

sock_dir.description: Set the directory used to hold unix sockets.

log_file.description: The location of the minion log file
